page.content:
Hitler's state, engine of the European war and the Holocaust.

How Nazi Germany connects

  • Character: Adolf Hitler — Hitler dictated Nazi Germany.
  • Event: Holocaust — The Nazi state organized the Holocaust.
  • Faction: Axis — Nazi Germany was the European core of the Axis.
  • Event: Invasion of Poland — Germany's invasion of Poland opened the European war.
  • Event: Battle of Stalingrad — The Sixth Army's destruction at Stalingrad broke Germany's eastern offensive.

What is Nazi Germany?

Nazi Germany remilitarized, annexed, and then invaded its neighbors. Its racial state murdered Europe's Jews and millions of others while fighting a two-front war it could not sustain.

Key threads lead to Adolf Hitler, Holocaust, Axis, Invasion of Poland and Battle of Stalingrad.
